title: Social and Multiplayer Cognition
purpose: A proposed course in the Corniversity catalogue (Optional elective). Mental-state inference, cooperation, coordination, communication and strategic interaction, how social information changes decisions, and how competing accounts can be tested. A subject in its own right, not a game-design assignment.
description: Proposed course: Social and Multiplayer Cognition. Central question: How do people infer others' mental states and coordinate, communicate and compete with them? Source verification and syllabus design have not been completed, so no teaching material exists yet. You may register interest or ask the director about it; nothing is prepared on request.
